title: Long Tunnel Tent with Reduced Vestibule
description: One complete static longitudinal tunnel camping tent with an integral closed floor and rear, a reduced-height forward vestibule transitioning into a taller deep sleeping cavity, and a genuinely open front entry with finite fabric returns and raised sill. Three complete parallel noncrossing hoop supports follow the enclosure; the newly authored full enclosure and vestibule topology are not an enlarged crossing-pole dome or a playground through-tunnel with extra poles. One whole model, zero scenes. No people, equipment, detached stakes or old geometry. Static game-art appearance only: no occupancy, wearable fit, pitching, deployment, weatherproofing, ventilation, insulation, load or camping safety claims.
